feedback_variant: first 626 bytes (3 whole frames) of controls/mp3/tone-44k-mono.mp3
coverage: Python line tracing of TinyTag package source during valid-control replay; lines inside the _MPEG frame-header class are counted separately and _ID3 lines must be zero; Atheris import instrumentation for fuzz entry
coverage_limit: Untagged MPEG Layer III only. TinyTag picks its _MPEG reader from the frame sync at byte 0, walks frame headers, and for a stream without Xing/Info/VBRI stops after five equal-bitrate frames and estimates duration from stream size divided by their mean frame length. It reports sample rate, channels, bitrate and duration, not MPEG version, layer or frame count. It does not decode audio. The two full-length CBR controls run the same TinyTag lines; parser feedback differs only for a valid three-frame prefix that ends before CBR detection. Two valid CBR controls do not establish VBR, free-format, Layer I/II, or MPEG-2.5 support.
